question: Should Control UI assistant-message copy become a per-click Markdown/plain-text menu, a persisted copy-format preference, or remain Markdown-only for now?
rationale: The implementation boundary is small, but the visible action shape and plain-text conversion semantics affect core Control UI UX and may add i18n or preference surface.

options.title: Use a per-click format menu
options.body: Add a compact menu beside the existing assistant copy action with Markdown and Plain Text options, avoiding new persisted settings while solving the reported workflow.

options.title: Add a persisted preference
options.body: Add a user preference for default copy format, accepting extra settings and upgrade/i18n surface to reduce repeated choice for users who always want plain text.

options.title: Keep Markdown-only
options.body: Close or defer the request if maintainers decide another action in the assistant bubble is not worth the UI complexity right now.

recommendation.title: Use a per-click format menu
recommendation.body: Add a compact menu beside the existing assistant copy action with Markdown and Plain Text options, avoiding new persisted settings while solving the reported workflow.

likelyOwner.reason: The original copy-as-markdown behavior and current copied helper path trace most strongly to steipete, making them the best available routing owner for the UX direction.
